uncited: It operates as a specific rasterization step within [Image-based Voxelization](12822-image-based-voxelization.md) [Parent].
- The image is treated as a 2D grid where image width maps to the X-axis and image height maps to the Z-axis [Parent].
**Precompute Raw Heights:** Iterate through every pixel $(u, v)$ across image width $W$ and height $H$.
- **Boundary Pixels:** Pixels on the edge lack neighbors on one or more sides.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(W \times H)$, where $W$ and $H$ are image dimensions.
- **Memory Complexity:** $O(W \times H)$ for the output voxel list.
